narrative:
## Handover Summary — Production Revenue & Hedge Book

Revenue validated across six assets, seven commodities and four contract types. The Production Revenue & Hedge Book Agent generated 15 proposals; 11 were accepted.

## Key Decisions
• Price deck reset to USD 72/bbl Brent for planning, with the USD 75 budget held as upside
• Sales gas volume +3% from Al-Rimal phase 2 (+USD 0.8B)
• Offshore volume trimmed 2% for the turnaround extension
• Spot LNG realizations +5% on the JKM premium

## Recommendation for Cost of Sales
Royalties move with price — the cost team should re-run the royalty tier at USD 72 Brent and re-baseline VLCC freight, now running 29% above plan.

signals.title: Refining margin squeeze at international JVs
signals.excerpt: International Refining JVs run at 68% cost of sales; a $2/bbl drop in the Singapore complex margin costs about $2B of EBITDA.

signals.title: VLCC freight above plan
signals.excerpt: Arabian Gulf–Asia VLCC rates average $58,000/day versus $45,000 in plan on Red Sea re-routing.
